effective_date_policy: Explicit document date required; ordinary, emergency, franchise, appropriations/tax/local-improvement and referendum exceptions are not interchangeable.
unverified_exceptions: special procedural motions and suspension of rules
notes: Composite snapshot begins October 3, 2025, matching the current council-action amendment. Do not apply to earlier meetings without archived rules. Calculations are review checks, not legal conclusions. Committee rules require their own effective-dated configuration.

unverified_exceptions: motion to close debate depends on attendance
notes: Current rules say adopted March 19, 2026. Ordinary action requires majority of all members except specified exceptions. Chair votes; no abstention unless excused for actual conflict. County rules are never inherited from Portland. Special motions remain held until independently configured.
